review_notes: Reviewed all 61 lines, the root-cut definitions, and the comparison, norm-bound and cell-constancy lemmas used by the proof. Checked the proposed replacement lemmas in source; the replacement was not compiled.

findings.excerpt:
have hrootA : movingTopRootCuts value hvalue childBound pivotBound T hf XR ⊆ roots := by
    intro x hx
    exact Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_union_left _ hx)
findings.problem: This inclusion is proved elementwise even though it is simply the composition of two left-union inclusions.
findings.proposed_change:
Replace these lines with:
  have hrootA : movingTopRootCuts value hvalue childBound pivotBound T hf XR ⊆ roots :=
    Finset.subset_union_left.trans Finset.subset_union_left
findings.benefit: States the inclusion argument directly without introducing an arbitrary element or manipulating membership proofs. The two union inclusions remain explicit, and the argument also covers empty root sets.
